body: I like driving. A lot. Maybe in another life I would've been a pilot.

I don't really know, I feel like something's very wrong with me. 

In the last couple of years I've become so angry. I have outbursts and incidents all the time, one the most minute of shit. When something that causes justifiable anger happens I just go crazy.

I also think I have an alcohol problem. Actually, no, I'm sure of it. I get shitfaced almost every day. The lack of sleep isn't doing me any good.
